name: sidelens
description: You should know for every model provider: a side agent watches longer tasks and surfaces things worth knowing above the prompt.

autoSend.title: Auto-send to main agent
autoSend.description: When an explanation appears, send the note to the main agent automatically and close the panel, instead of waiting for Chat in main session.

backlog.title: Keep earlier notes in a backlog
backlog.description: While an explanation is waiting, keep checking and hold up to three new notes. When you handle the open note, the next earlier note appears, labeled with when it was found. Off while autoSend is on.

checkCadence.title: When to check for notes
checkCadence.description: fixed keeps the built-in six-step cadence. turnEnd checks once, after a turn finishes, so short turns are covered and long turns are judged on completed work. Off while autoSend is on.
